mapper.insert: INSERT INTO duty_schedule (staff_id, staff_type, duty_date, slot_id, room_id, capacity, reserved_count, status, create_time) VALUES (#{staffId}, #{staffType}, #{dutyDate}, #{slotId}, #{roomId}, #{capacity}, #{reservedCount}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE duty_schedule SET reserved_count = reserved_count + #{count}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND reserved_count + #{count} <= capacity
UPDATE duty_schedule SET reserved_count = GREATEST(reserved_count - #{count}, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
